title: Longest Common Prefix
description: Find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings.

data.text: Write a function to find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings. If there is no common prefix, return `""`.

data.title: Character by character O(n * m)
Sort first/last O(n log n)
What improved?
data.text: Sorting lets us compare only the lexicographically smallest and largest strings. Their common prefix is the common prefix for the whole array.
